title: Blooded Circle
summary: The Blooded Circle is a council consisting of the five highest level members of the Blood Spiral. Commanded by Rassimov, they would convene at the Throne of Lies, before Rassimov and the Betrayer's corpse, and plot their next moves. Each member's place in the circle is highly regarded, and if a member leaves, they must be replaced by a Seeker who has proven themself to be just as powerful.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Blooded Circle met before Rassimov where Shauna informed him that Stack hoped to join the Blood Spiral and offered to acquire them Medusa as proof of his allegiance. Although initially order them to destroy him, Rassimov's mind changed when Tantras suggested they send Kiel and his Casterwill Hunters to Medusa's Island. [Zhalia's Mission]

Following Kiel's downfall, Marduk took his place in the Blooded Circle. [An Ally from the Organization]

After Tantras lost all his power to the Heart of Vlad Dracul, he lost his place in the circle. However, Harrison Fears then took his place. [Rassimov's Secret]

On the longest night of the year, the Betrayer's spirit appeared before the Blooded Circle, warning them that Sophie Casterwill would stand at Nostradamus' Tomb at sundown. When Harrison expressed concern, saying Sophie's name, Shauna punished him by hitting him with a Bladewave. Rassimov then sent Marduk to finish her. [Words from Eathon]
